purpose: Test whether later capacity level, local fade rate, or curvature can repair the RC55 failure of the first-160-cycle fade coordinate. The RWTH outcomes were opened in RC55, so no result from this analysis is confirmatory evidence.

cohort.rule: Use all 48 source cells, including the two former schema pilots, because every outcome is already open and this cycle makes no untouched-target claim.
cohort.batch: Start batch is floor((cell_id - 1) / 4) + 1, yielding 12 chronological four-cell blocks.
cohort.validation: Leave one complete start batch out. Fit on the other 44 cells and predict only the four omitted cells. Pool only within-held-batch comparable pairs so fold-specific intercepts cannot create artificial cross-batch ordering.
cohort.exclusions: A candidate row is unavailable only if the required standardized capacity rounds are missing, non-finite, non-positive, non-increasing in cycle, or its landmark is not earlier than the registered 80%-of-own-BOL event/censor observation. No outcome-based row deletion is allowed.

endpoint.definition: Remaining source cycles from the candidate landmark to the first observed standardized capacity round at or below 80% of the same cell's BOL capacity; no interpolation.
endpoint.event: All available RC55 cells are retained with their previously adjudicated event/censor flag.
endpoint.claimBoundary: This endpoint is an interval-resolved capacity threshold, not a hazard, safety, warranty, field-pack, or universal digital-twin endpoint.

features.rounds: R0 is BOL; R1, R2, and R3 are the first three later standardized full-capacity rounds. Actual source cycle positions, not nominal 160/320/480 labels, enter every derivative.
features.log_slope_curvature: recent log-capacity slope minus the immediately preceding log-capacity slope. It is a discrete change in fade rate, not a continuous second derivative.
features.preprocessing: Within each training fold, subtract the training mean and divide by its population standard deviation; apply those constants to the held batch. A zero training standard deviation makes the candidate unavailable.
features.model: One-feature Weibull accelerated-failure-time model with log(lambda_i)=intercept+beta*z_i, shared shape, and fixed L2 penalty alpha=1 on beta only. Initialization and BFGS settings match RC55.
features.prediction: Higher predicted median remaining cycles means longer life.

selection.coverageGate: At least 44 of 48 cells and all 12 held batches must yield predictions.
selection.rankingGate: Pooled within-held-batch Harrell concordance must be at least 0.65.
selection.directionGate: All 12 training-fold beta estimates and the full-cohort beta must have the same nonzero sign.
selection.choice: Among candidates satisfying every gate, select the earliest round; within that round use candidateOrder. If none passes, do not inspect Aurora cycling entries and report that the independent source is ready but no transportable coordinate was earned.
selection.prohibited: No threshold relaxation, nonlinear feature search, target-informed transformation, feature combination, or post-result reordering.

independentTransfer.boundary: Only assembly and protocol metadata may be inspected until a candidate passes and a separate Aurora precommit fixes exact cell IDs, cycle mapping, missingness, endpoint, sign, and gates.
independentTransfer.targetClaim: At most a rank-transport claim across laboratory, format, and chemistry; absolute RUL calibration is out of scope.
independentTransfer.minimumGatesToPrecommit: At least 90% target coverage, at least 24 observed 80% events, at least 100 comparable pairs, concordance at least 0.65, and a 2000-bootstrap 95% lower bound above 0.50, with an independent implementation.

safetyAndScope: Only public historical battery data are processed. No cell operation, destructive experiment, personal data, cyber-trust experiment, operational safety decision, or deployment occurs.
